description: This file provides utility functions for type checking and inspection, including checks for Uint8Array, ArrayBuffer, RegExp, Map, and Date, as well as a default inspection function and a stylize function accessor. It includes internal utilities to retrieve type information based on object prototypes and symbols.

methods.name: export function isUint8Array(value: unknown): value is Uint8Array { isUint8Array
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a Uint8Array.

methods.name: export function isAnyArrayBuffer(value: unknown): value is ArrayBuffer { isAnyArrayBuffer
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is an ArrayBuffer or SharedArrayBuffer.

methods.name: export function isRegExp(regexp: unknown): regexp is RegExp { isRegExp
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a RegExp object.

methods.name: export function isMap(value: unknown): value is Map<unknown, unknown> { isMap
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a Map.

methods.name: export function isDate(date: unknown): date is Date { isDate
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a Date object.

methods.name: export function defaultInspect(x: unknown, _options?: unknown): string { defaultInspect
methods.description: Default inspection function that serializes a value to string, handling BigInt and Map specially.

methods.name: export function getStylizeFunction(options?: unknown): StylizeFunction | undefined { getStylizeFunction
methods.description: Function to retrieve a stylize function from options if available.

ctags.pattern: /^export type InspectFn = (x: unknown, options?: unknown) => string;$/
